1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeChainPaths
2 
3 /-! All distinct kites in the one chosen global development are
4 nonoverlapping. The numerical budget comes from the actual source cone. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
11   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
13 
14 include small_faces
15 
16 /-- Every distinct pair of tree-edge kites is separated in the fixed common plane. -/
17 theorem global_kites_nonoverlap {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
18     (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (source : Fin 6)
19     (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
20     {u v w z : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z)
21     (different : s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z)) :
22     Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last)) := by
23   obtain ⟨n, chain, first_same, last_same⟩ := T.exists_chain_between_edges first last different
24   have first_image : charts.kite (chain.edge 0) = charts.kite first :=
25     charts.kite_eq_of_same_edge _ first first_same
26   have last_image : charts.kite (chain.edge (Fin.last n).succ) = charts.kite last :=
27     charts.kite_eq_of_same_edge _ last last_same
28   rw [← first_image, ← last_image]
29   exact graph.cut_tree_chain_end_kites_nonoverlap small_faces T charts chain source at_source
30 
31 /-- Construct the actual, covering chart collection with all its kites separated. -/
32 theorem exists_separated_cut_tree_charts {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
33     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
34     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
35     ∃ charts : CutTreeCharts T,
36       ∀ {u v w z : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z),
37         s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z) → Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last)) := by
38   obtain ⟨charts⟩ := graph.exists_cut_tree_charts small_faces a T cofacial
39   exact ⟨charts, fun first last different =>
40     graph.global_kites_nonoverlap small_faces T charts source at_source first last different⟩
41 
42 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
